Locates the optional MOISTURE block and dispatches its current key/value labels.

Contains the active first-five-character finite-element command dispatch and line-option handling.

On included-file EOF, closes the current include unit and resumes the parent include or root FE stream.
Defines the DIMENSIONS, NODE, ELEMENT, NSET, and ELSET data-row grammars and next-command termination.
Defines nested integration-point records and nodal or elemental orientation records.
Requires one thickness/material row per declared layer, normalizes thicknesses, and applies the section to the selected element set.
Requires BOUNDARY and begins dispatch of boundary problem types and nested controls.
Defines mechanical/thermal problem starts and the active nested BOUNDARY command dispatch through convergence and output controls.
Defines penalty types -2/-21, nodal, and surface connection headers, subordinate set rows, defaults, sentinels, and cross-reference checks.
Defines static, fatigue, 2D-fatigue, reduced-fatigue, block repetition, and boundary-condition change records.
Defines D_AA, active four-character convergence labels, values, defaults, and the twelve-record scan limit.
Defines data-file, sum-force, volume-average, traction-average, and CFV output records and selectors.
Defines all/list/qualified-name selection for clusters and cluster-qualified node or element sets.
Requires CONSTITUTIVE, dispatches constitutive type records, and reads the current *MIC value array.
Locates optional TABLES and divides table entries at *end records.
Locates the optional exact STATISTICAL start token and divides entries at *end records until END STATISTICAL DISTRIBUTIONS.
Requires MATERIALS and dispatches legacy numeric and newer representations, including numeric or named Mises material type 50.
Locates optional FAILURE and dispatches failure criterion records, including interface-family types 34, 35, and 36.
Locates optional USER and begins dispatch of numeric user-function types.
Locates optional CRACK and dispatches current FE crack types 101, 201, and 301.
Current project deck assembled from pre-existing mesh data using INPUT type 3, MATERIALS, CLUSTERS, and current FE commands; VTMS may have assembled or visualized the mesh but did not generate it.
Current multi-cluster project deck assembled from pre-existing mesh data that demonstrates repeated solid cluster records; VTMS may have assembled or visualized the mesh but did not generate it.
Defines -I/-O directory flags, optional .in removal, basename handling, and output artifact stems.
Writes the explicit end-of-program timing sentinel after all boundary problems finish.
Defines .exit values 0 continue, 1 disrupt, and 2 stop.
